code.description: HTTP status code of the answer

message.description: What went wrong, in English; internal errors only say Internal Error

message_i18n.description: Key the web interface translates instead of the English message, when the error has one

output.description: nginx, certbot or database driver output that explains the failure, shortened to its end

message_values.description: Values filled into the translated message (names and numbers the message mentions)

saved_id.description: Identifier of the host that was saved although nginx refused to reload; only on a reload error

saved_certificate_id.description: Identifier of the certificate saved with that host; only on a reload error

checks.description: The checks of a refused CrowdSec save, one line each, never a key

force_blocked.description: Whether the refused save cannot be forced, because a check failed that force does not skip
